# InvestingNoobs Academy

> InvestingNoobs Academy is a free, browser-based course for learning cryptocurrency, investing and trading fundamentals. It is designed for complete beginners and teaches a repeatable, risk-aware process rather than predictions or guaranteed returns.

## Learning path

Read the 50 chapters in order. Each chapter includes a plain-English explanation, a worked example, a pre-action checklist, a practice exercise and further reading. The final assessment contains one practical question for each lesson and requires 80% to pass.

## Editorial policy

InvestingNoobs is educational content, not personal financial, legal or tax advice. Markets can be volatile, prices and data can be delayed, and users can lose some or all of their capital. Readers should verify current rules, fees, product availability and tax treatment with authoritative sources in their country.
